title: The Hand Washing Song | Staying Clean And Healthy | Noodle & Pals
speaker: Noodle & Pals
zh: 【Noodle & Pals】洗手歌曲|保持清潔和健康|麵條和朋友們（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Let's wash our hands together.
cues.en: Let's wash our hands together.
cues.zh: 我們一起洗手吧。

cues.text: Are you ready?
cues.en: Are you ready?
cues.zh: 你準備好了嗎？

cues.text: Here we go.
cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 開始了。

cues.text: ♪ Wash your hands with me ♪ ♪ To make them nice and clean ♪
cues.en: ♪ Wash your hands with me ♪ ♪ To make them nice and clean ♪
cues.zh: ♪ 和我一起洗手 ♪ ♪ 讓雙手變得乾淨整潔 ♪

cues.text: ♪ Let's wet our hands ♪ ♪ Get some soap ♪ ♪ Wash your hands with me ♪
cues.en: ♪ Let's wet our hands ♪ ♪ Get some soap ♪ ♪ Wash your hands with me ♪
cues.zh: ♪ 讓我們弄濕我們的手 ♪ ♪ 拿點肥皂 ♪ ♪ 和我一起洗手 ♪

cues.text: ♪ Scrub rub-a-dub-dub ♪ ♪ Twist your hands together ♪
cues.en: ♪ Scrub rub-a-dub-dub ♪ ♪ Twist your hands together ♪
cues.zh: ♪ 擦擦擦擦 ♪ ♪ 雙手扭在一起 ♪

cues.text: ♪ Scrub rub-a-dub-dub ♪ ♪ In between your fingers ♪
cues.en: ♪ Scrub rub-a-dub-dub ♪ ♪ In between your fingers ♪
cues.zh: ♪ 擦擦擦擦 ♪ ♪ 在你的手指之間 ♪

cues.text: ♪ Scrub rub-a-dub-dub ♪ ♪ Don't forget the top ♪
cues.en: ♪ Scrub rub-a-dub-dub ♪ ♪ Don't forget the top ♪
cues.zh: ♪ 擦洗擦-a-dub-dub ♪ ♪ 別忘了頂部 ♪

cues.text: ♪ Scrub rub-a-dub-dub your thumbs ♪ ♪ And then we stop ♪
cues.en: ♪ Scrub rub-a-dub-dub your thumbs ♪ ♪ And then we stop ♪
cues.zh: ♪ 擦、擦、擦、擦你的拇指 ♪ ♪ 然後我們就停下來 ♪

cues.text: ♪ Now it's time to rinse ♪ ♪ We've cleaned our fingertips ♪
cues.en: ♪ Now it's time to rinse ♪ ♪ We've cleaned our fingertips ♪
cues.zh: ♪ 現在是沖洗的時候了 ♪ ♪ 我們已經清潔了指尖 ♪

cues.text: ♪ This is the hand washing song ♪ Did you do it?
cues.en: ♪ This is the hand washing song ♪ Did you do it?
cues.zh: ♪ 這是洗手歌 ♪ 你做到了嗎？

cues.text: Yeah?
cues.en: Yeah?
cues.zh: 是的？

cues.text: Let's try one more time.
cues.en: Let's try one more time.
cues.zh: 我們再試一次吧。
